ride.font: Fredoka Bold (SIL OFL 1.1) for the wordmark and slates

mini.universal_key: double-ended, 1.0 mm disc at the join; turn the first end by the other end's lugs, then quarter-turn the second cube
mini.adapter: two full TURN keys at 42 mm under a 70 x 36 flange; one mini socket on an 18 mm boss above the key grips

bike.straps: two 25 mm straps round the rack platform

scoot.strap: one 25 mm hook-and-loop or cam strap, no tools, removable
scoot.takes: the fixed-line rod packed (32 mm grip) or the cast rod packed (36 mm grip)

scooters.Flamingo (share): stem not measured; strap-on only, remove before returning the scooter
scooters.Lime Gen4 (share): stem not measured; strap-on only, remove before returning the scooter
scooters.Honey Whale (owned folder): stem not measured; strap-on, or the bar saddle on the handlebar

fish_ruler.datum: the stadium apex at each end; lid and base end to end

ruler_150.lives_in: long pod pen slot (middle two, 157 mm)

ruler.status: designed and checked digitally; nothing printed. Check every scale against a steel rule on the first print.

qr.note: the real code is made per order from the owner's id page address; the sample is not a live page

pocket.pockets_from: published product sizes with clearance (AirPods Pro 2 60.6 × 45.2 × 21.7; Anker Nano 77 × 36.8 × 25; compact tampon ~80 × Ø17; 15 mL spray ~76 × Ø25; Staedtler 526 50 65 × 23 × 13; G2 refill 98.1 × Ø5.8)
pocket.status: designed and checked digitally; nothing printed. Every pocket is checked against the real thing on the first print.
